recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-47465 unless OO later changes ServiceRequest intent-transition semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-47465 was an Applied FHIR-core ServiceRequest change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking how to handle a proposal becoming an order. The final resolution directed ServiceRequest.intent to use the Request.intent immutability guidance with Request references changed to ServiceRequest.
initial_application: The requested wording was already applied before this reconciliation: c3f9df3563c8e067ea5137628a5e985b1d911f6e replaced the old ServiceRequest.intent comment, c59831db3845b3c58bd305221096aea541bbbeec corrected XML quoting, and 42131285033ba6d789e32191b1fdba888f2443f0 updated the ServiceRequest Request-pattern mapping exception.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml plus source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml both carry the approved basedOn/new-instance wording. OO Confluence minutes from 2024-11-15 and 2025-04-08 record the same text and the final 6-0-0 approval. Jira, Zulip, Confluence, and source searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source edits were made. The current authoritative ServiceRequest element comment and the request-mapping exception already state that a proposal should not become an order in-place; instead, a new instance basedOn the prior instance should be created, with only intent granularity refinements allowed.

related_jiras.note: A later ServiceRequest source-maintenance commit also updated the Request mapping exception, leaving the FHIR-47465 comment synchronized in the current source.
